headline: 今日AI速览：学术研究最活跃
narrative:
今日共收录280篇AI新闻，分类分布：学术研究203篇, 开源项目35篇, 模型发布30篇, 产品/API12篇。热门标签：Agent（54篇）。其中17%的文章有多来源交叉验证。

▸ affaan-m /ECC：The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research

▸ huggingface /speech-to-speech：Build local voice agents with open-source models

▸ microsoft /VibeVoice：Open-Source Frontier Voice AI

▸ different-ai /openwork：The open-source alternative to Claude Cowork (powered by opencode)
